# archestra_knowledge_connector (Resource)

A knowledge connector syncs documents from an external source (Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Google Drive, a website, ...) into knowledge bases. Terraform manages its configuration; documents, sync runs and per-member overrides stay in the UI. Google Drive in individual (`oauth`) mode is created without credentials and must then be authorized in the UI. Destroying the connector moves it to the trash, where an administrator can restore or purge it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A knowledge connector syncs documents from an external source into
# knowledge bases. `config` takes the source's settings as JSON with the
# API's camelCase keys; leave out `type`, the provider adds it from
# `connector_type`.
#
# Destroying a connector moves it to the trash. Documents, sync runs and
# per-member overrides are managed in the UI.

resource "archestra_knowledge_base" "docs" {
  name = "Product Docs"
}

# Web crawler: needs no credentials.
resource "archestra_knowledge_connector" "docs_site" {
  name           = "Docs site"
  connector_type = "web_crawler"
  config = jsonencode({
    startUrl = "https://docs.example.com"
    maxPages = 200
  })
  schedule           = "0 3 * * *"
  knowledge_base_ids = [archestra_knowledge_base.docs.id]
}

# Jira: credentials are write-only and never read back.
variable "jira_api_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "archestra_knowledge_connector" "jira" {
  name           = "Engineering Jira"
  connector_type = "jira"
  config = jsonencode({
    jiraBaseUrl = "https://example.atlassian.net"
    isCloud     = true
    projectKey  = "ENG"
  })
  credentials = {
    email     = "bot@example.com"
    api_token = var.jira_api_token
  }
  knowledge_base_ids = [archestra_knowledge_base.docs.id]
}

# Google Drive in individual mode: created without credentials, then
# authorized once in the UI (needs the deployment's Google OAuth client).
resource "archestra_knowledge_connector" "drive" {
  name           = "Team Drive"
  connector_type = "gdrive"
  config = jsonencode({
    authMode = "oauth"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) Type-specific settings as a JSON object, usually written with `jsonencode()`, using the API's camelCase keys (for example `{ startUrl = "https://docs.example.com", maxPages = 200 }` for `web_crawler`). Leave out the `type` key: the provider adds it from `connector_type`. Keys you leave out keep their server defaults and are not tracked; URL normalization by the API is not reported as drift.
- `connector_type` (String) Source type: `jira`, `confluence`, `github`, `gitlab`, `servicenow`, `notion`, `sharepoint`, `gdrive`, `dropbox`, `onedrive`, `asana`, `linear`, `outline`, `salesforce`, `web_crawler`, `perforce`, `mfiles`. Changing it replaces the connector.
- `name` (String) Connector name.

### Optional

- `credentials` (Attributes) Inline credentials for the source. Write-only: the API never returns them, so Terraform cannot detect out-of-band changes. Required by most types; not allowed for `web_crawler`, GitHub App connectors or Google Drive in `oauth` mode. Removing the block leaves the stored credentials in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether scheduled syncs run (server default `true`). Omit to keep the current value; the API has no reset, so removing it from configuration leaves the server value in place.
- `environment_id` (String) Deployment environment the connector syncs in. The API picks the default environment when omitted. Omit to keep the current value; the API has no reset, so removing it from configuration leaves the server value in place.
- `fts_language` (String) Full-text search language for indexed documents. Omit to keep the current value; the API has no reset, so removing it from configuration leaves the server value in place.
- `knowledge_base_ids` (Set of String) Knowledge bases that receive this connector's documents. Omit to leave assignments unmanaged; an empty set removes every assignment.
- `labels` (Attributes Set) Connector labels. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))
- `permission_sync_interval_seconds` (Number) How often permissions are re-synced, in seconds, when `sync_permissions_from_source` is on. Omit to keep the current value; the API has no reset, so removing it from configuration leaves the server value in place.
- `permissions` (Attributes Set) Additional direct sharing grants on this object. Applied atomically on creation and reconciled in place thereafter. Omit to preserve current grants; set [] to clear additional grants. The owner's existing grant is preserved automatically; inherited access and ownership remain managed by Archestra. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
- `schedule` (String) Cron schedule for content syncs (server default `0 */6 * * *`). Omit to keep the current value; the API has no reset, so removing it from configuration leaves the server value in place.
- `sync_permissions_from_source` (Boolean) Mirror each document's access control from the source, so searches return only what the caller could open there. Needs an enterprise license and a source type that supports it. Omit to keep the current value; the API has no reset, so removing it from configuration leaves the server value in place.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Connector identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Required:

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) API token, password or private key, depending on the source.

Optional:

- `admin_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Atlassian organization admin API key, used to resolve managed-account emails during permission sync.
- `email` (String) Account email, for sources that authenticate with email plus token (Jira, Confluence).


<a id="nestedatt--labels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `labels`

Required:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Required:

- `actions` (Set of String) Actions granted to the principal.
- `subject_id` (String) Principal ID; use * for the organization principal.
- `subject_type` (String) Principal type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_knowledge_connector.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
